cards.name: Species majority bonus
cards.flag: inert: changes the winner in only about 5% of games at bonus 8

cards.name: Lifebuoy refund
cards.flag: inert: refunded about 0.56 times per game and changes no measurable outcome

cards.name: Bait (leave one card)
cards.flag: dominated: leaving the lowest card is the right choice about 3 turns in 4

ambiguities: River with only 1 card at banking: section 4 says at least 2, but it can be 1 (deck runs out after the first flip, or a Lifebuoy is spent on a second-flip clash). Interpreted: you take the single card.
Safe scout when the deck runs dry: if every remaining card matches the river the scout redraws until the deck is empty with an empty pile, and the game ends (consistent with section 5).
Refund counting: the card you leave counts toward the 4 cards, and the refund only applies if the Lifebuoy was spent. Interpreted by the playtester; not stated in the rules.
Multiple leftovers: only 0 or 1 leftover can exist, so the 'other leftovers stay in the river' wording in section 4 is dead text.
Lifebuoy on a bait clash: spending it keeps your pile and you must bank the bait. Allowed, but not stated.
Tiebreaker: equal score, then more cards, then the second player. Assumed.

problems.problem: Bait/leave decision is solved by 'leave your lowest card'
problems.evidence: Leaving high wins 17-24% and random 31-36% against leave-lowest; the best clever leave rule gains only +2 to +3 points. The answer is 'lowest' about 3 turns in 4.
problems.fix: Make a bait hit pay more (bait owner also takes a card from the opponent's pile, or the pile counts double), then re-run experiments.py section A. Target: leave-lowest under 60% against a smart leaver.

problems.problem: Species bonus decides only about 5% of games
problems.evidence: Flips the winner in 4.8% of games at bonus 8 (v1: about 4% at 5). The species-aware leave rule scores 45-47% against plain lowest, so chasing species costs more than it gains.
problems.fix: Score the bonus per card of margin (for example +3 per card ahead) or raise it to 12-15, then re-run section E. Target: swings 10%+ of games.

problems.problem: Pushing deep is not rewarded and the Lifebuoy refund is rarely used
problems.evidence: Pusher targets 4 to 20 all win 35-40% against strategic. Refund happens 0.56 times per game. Refund at 3 re-tilts seat 1 to 55.5%.
problems.fix: Move the refund to 3 cards with seat 2 +4, or drop the refund and keep a one-shot Lifebuoy.

problems.evidence: 10-17% of turns; average bust pile 5.6 points, none reach 15.
problems.fix: Optionally make the Lifebuoy free when the pile is one card.

problems.evidence: The leader after one third of the game wins 66-70%. Unchanged from v1.
Small over-correction from the +3 compensation; no bot is further than 2 points from fair.
